stem: Why is it important to the plot that Sherry uses hand sanitizer?

options.label: A
options.text: Sherry is able to thoroughly wash any bacteria off her hands.

options.label: B
options.text: Sherry notices that only a few drops of hand sanitizer are left in the bottle.

options.label: C
options.text: Sherry gets an idea for a new experiment from observing a drop of hand sanitizer.

options.label: D
options.text: Sherry cleans up the mess on the kitchen table.
